transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I keep hearing this man’s voice. It sounds like it’s coming from the garage vents, or sometimes from under the hood when I’m working on a car. It’s clear, like somebody standing right next to me, and it tells me not to trust my husband or not to touch certain cars. It’s been really bothering me.

Do you experience any other unusual sensations or perceptions, such as seeing things that aren't there, feeling something on your skin when there's nothing, or smelling odd odors that others don't notice?

Mostly it’s the voice. I haven’t really noticed seeing things or feeling stuff on my skin. The thing that keeps happening is that man’s voice, like from the vents at work or under a car hood, clear like he’s right there, telling me not to trust my husband or not to touch certain cars.
Have you ever seen things that others around you don't seem to see, like shadows, figures, or objects that aren't really there?
No, I don’t really see shadows or figures or anything like that. It’s more the voice I keep hearing, like a man talking from the vents or under the hood when I’m working.
Do you ever believe things that others don’t, or have thoughts that people around you seem confused about?

Yeah… I mean, I know it probably sounds far-fetched, but I really do think my husband and the shop owner have been using the EV chargers and the security cameras to keep track of what I’m doing. Even when they show me the footage and say there’s nothing there, I still feel convinced that they’re watching me somehow.
Are there any other unusual or strange ideas that you believe in, that other people might find hard to understand or accept?

It’s mostly that same thing… I’m still convinced my husband and the shop owner are tracking me through the EV chargers and the security cameras. I know people say that doesn’t make sense, and they’ve shown me footage where nothing looks wrong, but I still feel like they’re using it somehow to watch what I’m doing.

Are there any other beliefs or ideas that you hold that other people might find strange or difficult to understand, aside from the belief that you are being watched through the EV chargers and security cameras?
No, I don’t think so. Not aside from that. That’s really the main thing people keep telling me sounds strange.

Even though people have shown you evidence that you're not being watched, do you still feel absolutely certain that your husband and the shop owner are monitoring you through the EV chargers and cameras?

Yes. I know they say the footage doesn’t show anything, and I know it sounds far-fetched, but I still feel sure they’re doing it somehow. Like my husband and the shop owner are using the chargers and cameras to keep track of what I’m doing. I can’t shake that.

Do you believe that your husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and cameras in a way that involves something unusual, like mind control or some kind of special technology that others aren’t aware of?

I don’t know about mind control. I wouldn’t say that exactly. I just think they’re using something with the EV chargers and the security cameras to track me, something they’re not admitting to. Even when they show me the footage and say there’s nothing there, I still feel like they’ve found a way to watch what I’m doing.

Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or suspicions that are unrelated to being watched by your husband or the shop owner, such as beliefs about your health, identity, or other people’s intentions toward you?

No, not really. I don’t think I’ve had other beliefs like that about my health or who I am or anything. It’s mainly this thing with my husband and the shop owner using the EV chargers and cameras to track me. I know people say there’s no proof, but I still feel convinced that’s what’s happening.

Have you ever felt that people other than your husband or the shop owner were involved in this, or that there were other ways you were being targeted or harmed beyond being watched through the EV chargers and cameras?

No, I don’t really think it’s other people or other ways. It’s mainly my husband and the shop owner. I know it sounds far-fetched, but I’m still convinced they’re using the EV chargers and the security cameras to track what I’m doing, even when they show me footage and say nothing is there.
Have you ever had any other strong beliefs or suspicions that turned out not to be true, even if you initially felt certain about them?

I can’t really think of another one like that. It’s mostly this same thing I’ve been saying — I know it sounds far-fetched, but I’m still convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the security cameras to track what I’m doing. Even when they show me the footage and say there’s nothing there, I don’t fully believe it.
Have you ever had any other strong or unusual beliefs, even if you were the only one who believed them, that weren’t related to being watched by your husband or the shop owner?

No, I don’t think there’s anything else like that. It’s really just this one thing I keep coming back to — about my husband and the shop owner using the EV chargers and the security cameras to keep track of me. I know it sounds far-fetched, and people keep saying there’s nothing on the footage, but I still feel convinced there’s something going on.
